# ECHO

Show a text in the output.

## Syntax

```text
ECHO 'text'.
```

Pieces joined with + show as one line.

## Example

```text
ECHO 'Checks done'.
```

`statscraft help ECHO` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
